verdict.title: Minimum Bell-Setting Complexity for Qubit POVM–PVM Separation
verdict.review_type: independent analytic AI-assisted review with exact computation
verdict.strongest_supported_claim: For every finite input-dependent output architecture with two inputs per party and local dimension at most two, conv Q_POVM = conv Q_PVM. The rational three-by-two functional has attained POVM lower bound L0=20sqrt(2)+16/25 greater than the global PVM upper bound U=20sqrt(2)+3/5+(4+3sqrt(2))/250, with gap 3(2-sqrt(2))/250. Thus three-by-two, up to party exchange, is the minimum input architecture for such a linear Bell separation.

assumptions: Local Hilbert-space dimensions at most two.
Two inputs per party for equality; three-by-two for separation.
Shared-randomness convexification may select state and all measurements together.
Zero projectors, deterministic PVMs and local stochastic postprocessing allowed.
limits: No equality of raw nonconvex strategy images is established.
No same-state simulation or operator-level projective simulability is established.
No exact global POVM/PVM optimum of the displayed functional is established.
No privacy/randomness entropy claim or higher-dimensional/multipartite/sequential extension is established.
Not external human peer review or proof-assistant formalization.
Not a novelty/priority certificate or exhaustive literature review.

claim_scope: Local Hilbert dimensions at most two
Bipartite Bell behaviors with arbitrary finite input-dependent output alphabets
Shared-randomness convexified two-input POVM and PVM behavior hulls equal
Exact attained 3x2 lower bound above a global analytic PVM upper bound
Minimum input architecture 3x2 up to exchanging parties
excluded_claims: Exact global POVM/PVM optimum of the witness
Human peer review or formal verification

publication_conditions: Preserve convex-hull, fixed-qubit, finite-output, and input-count qualifications.
Do not present lower/upper certificates as exact optima.
Keep Zenodo metadata.version absent; distinguish printed July 2026 edition from file/archive label v1.1.0.
Keep companion assets bound to their own Zenodo records.
Separate mathematical gates must pass before publication.
